prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” personal injury lawyer for every Houston car wreck — the right attorney depends on the facts of your crash (severity of injuries, disputed liability, insurer behavior), your goals (quick settlement vs going to trial), and practical needs (language, budget, location). I can help you find the best match — but first here’s how to choose one and what to do next.

How to pick the right Houston car‑crash lawyer
- Look for relevant experience: many successful outcomes require a lawyer who handles motor-vehicle cases regularly and has trial experience for catastrophic or disputed-liability cases.  
- Proven results: past verdicts and settlements in similar cases (e.g., serious injuries, wrongful death) are meaningful.  
- Reputation and credentials: AV Preeminent / Martindale‑Hubbell ratings, Super Lawyers lists, peer recognition, and client reviews (Google, Avvo, Yelp).  
- Communication and availability: you want someone who responds, explains options, and will handle negotiations or trial if needed.  
- Fee structure: most personal injury lawyers work on contingency (they’re paid only if you recover). Confirm the percentage and any additional costs.  
- No disciplinary history: check the State Bar of Texas for any public discipline.

Immediate steps after a wreck (if this is recent)
1. Get medical care right away — your health is first and medical records document injuries.  
2. Preserve evidence: photos of vehicles, injuries, scene, license plates; keep police report number.  
3. Collect witness names/contacts and insurer info.  
4. Don’t give recorded statements to the other party’s insurer without your lawyer.  
5. Preserve vehicle repair estimates and medical bills.  
6. Contact an attorney promptly — statutes of limitation apply (usually two years in Texas for most personal injury claims, but exceptions exist).

What to ask at a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases do you handle per year? How many go to trial?  
- Can you share examples of outcomes in similar cases?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day (attorney vs. paralegal)?  
- What is your fee and what costs would I be responsible for up front?  
- How will you communicate progress and how often?

If you want, I can:
- Provide a short list of well‑rated Houston personal injury attorneys/firms tailored to your neighborhood, language needs, or case type (I’ll need your zip code or area).  
- Help draft questions for consultations or review a retainer agreement.

Tell me where in Houston you are (zip code or neighborhood) and a little about the crash (injury severity, fault disputes, whether insurers are already involved) and I’ll pull together a targeted shortlist and next steps.
